jobs.title: Health Specialist EFZ (40 - 90% | m/f/d)
jobs.description:
From June 1, 2026 or by arrangement
 The 4-star-plus Resort Hof Weissbad enjoys an excellent reputation as an innovative and successful company. In one of the most beautiful resorts in Eastern Switzerland, you will find not only a warm team spirit but also attractive employment conditions. We owe our success to our approximately 270 friendly and motivated employees.
 These are your tasks

• Independent care, support, and accompaniment of inpatient patients

• Professional execution of nursing measures within your own area of competence

• Responsible implementation of daily personal care and support of patients in daily life activities

• Recognizing changes and emergency situations, acting appropriately, and initiating necessary measures

• Taking over administrative and organizational tasks in everyday nursing
 What we expect from you

• Completed training as a Health Specialist EFZ or equivalent foreign training with SRK recognition or positive PreCheck

• Professional, empathetic demeanor, neat appearance, and very good manners

• Enjoyment in working with people and strong service orientation

• Internalized professional standards regarding hygiene, cleanliness, and structured work

• Team player and communicative personality

• Good observation skills, quick understanding of situations, and responsible actions

• Resilience and calmness even in demanding or hectic situations

• Willingness to work weekend shifts and flexible deployment for holiday cover
 What we offer you

• Catering : our kitchen also conjures up fresh, healthy, and subsidized meals for our employees

• Health : to stay fit and healthy, our employees use the bathing and fitness area free of charge

• Promotion : we support your professional development through cost-sharing for further training

• Discounts : you benefit from discounts in our hotel, in the region, as well as with partner companies of the ERFA group and the Private Selection Hotels

• Additional benefits : weekend bonuses and free parking

jobs.description:
Chef de Partie - Golf Restaurant Gonten 100 % (m | f | d)
 Immediate start or by arrangement

From 2026, Resort Hof Weissbad will take over the gastronomy of the Golf Restaurant Gonten, creating a new culinary experience for everyone. Whether after a round of golf, for a spontaneous visit, family celebrations, or corporate events: the publicly accessible restaurant will in future offer the culinary signature of Resort Hof Weissbad.

Become part of our kitchen team. You can expect an exciting project in the successful, family-run, and growth-oriented Resort Hof Weissbad, with many opportunities to realize your ideas.
 These are your tasks

• You work independently in a varied kitchen

• You create contemporary, creative, and high-quality dishes

• You help ensure smooth workflows

• You comply with quality and hygiene guidelines and carry out quality checks of goods
 What we expect from you

• You have training as a cook EFZ

• You have already gained professional experience in a similar position

• You have excellent expertise in your field

• You are an organizational talent

• You are flexible and can be deployed in all kitchen stations

• Your commitment and flexibility distinguish you

• You are creative and have high quality and hygiene standards
 What we offer you

• Meals : our kitchen also conjures up fresh, healthy, and subsidized meals for our employees

• Health : to stay fit and healthy, our employees use the bathing and fitness area free of charge

• Employee accommodation : affordable employee accommodations available in the area

• Support : we promote your professional development through cost-sharing for further training

• Discounts : you benefit from discounts in our hotel, in the region, as well as with partner companies of the ERFA group and the Private Selection Hotels

• Additional benefits : weekend bonuses and free parking
 Sounds like your dream job? Then get to know us – we look forward to people who are passionate hosts with us .

jobs.title: Praktikum Physiotherapie (100 % | m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Nach Vereinbarung
 Wir suchen Menschen mit Passion. Für ihren Beruf, für das Team und unsere Gäste. Als innovatives und erfolgreiches Unternehmen bieten wir in einem der schönsten Resorts der Ostschweiz attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen. Den Erfolg verdanken wir unseren rund 270 freundlichen und motivierten Mitarbeitenden mit grossartigem Teamgeist.
 Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Durchführen der physiotherapeutischen Behandlungen gemäss Verordnung, koordiniert von den Planungsverantwortlichen

• Konsequentes Führen eines digitalen Verlaufs- und Befundblattes zum Nachweis der gemachten Therapie

• Erledigung der administrativen Aufgaben nach Vorgaben des Leiters Therapie

• Persönliche Betreuung der Patienten bei der medizinischen Trainingstherapie

• Exaktes, zeitliches Einhalten des Einsatzplanes nach Vorgabe der Planungsverantwortlichen

• Abgabe und Verkauf von medizinischen Hilfsmitteln

• Erstellen von Verlaufsberichten auf Wunsch der Versicherer
 Das wünschen wir uns von dir

• Du bist im Studium zum Physiotherapeuten oder befindest dich in Ausbildung zum Dipl. Physiotherapeuten HF

• Du hast ein starkes Interesse am Bewegungsapparat sowie an medizinischen und therapeutischen Zusammenhängen

• Du hast Freude am persönlichen Gästekontakt sowie an der individuellen Betreuung und Beratung

• Du hast eine hohe Dienstleistungsorientierung, Engagement und Begeisterung für den Beruf

• Du sprichst Deutsch – weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus
 Das bieten wir dir

• Team Spirit: offene, respektvolle Teamkultur mit Freude an der gemeinsamen Arbeit

• Gesundheit: Um fit und gesund zu bleiben, nutzen unsere Mitarbeitenden den Bade- und Fitnessbereich kostenlos

• Verpflegung: Unsere Küche zaubert auch für unsere Mitarbeitenden frische, gesunde und subventionierte Mahlzeiten

• Vergünstigungen: Du profitierst von Vergünstigungen in unserem Hotel, in der Region sowie bei Partnerbetrieben der ERFA-Gruppe und den Private Selection Hotels

• Weitere Benefits: Gratis-Parkplatz und Appenzeller Mitarbeiterkarte
